title: Diesel Heat in Zero-Emission Fleets: reproduction package
description: Code, inputs, archived solver results and logs reproducing every number, table and figure of 'Diesel Heat in Zero-Emission Fleets: Stochastic Planning and Operation of Cold-Climate Electric Buses'. Two-stage stochastic MILP for cold-climate battery-electric bus fleet planning with fuel-fired-heater retention, EVSE-coupled preconditioning, emissions policy and division-scale coordination. This version (v2.0.0) supersedes v1.0.1: every thermal input was re-estimated from the revised companion study and the vehicle and battery costs were corrected to CAD, so all results changed. It adds the implied depot-configuration sweep, the reliability-matched premium, and a soft cabin-heat balance used to compute the value of the stochastic solution.
